themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their capabilities, limitations, and integration into research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and understanding code, including discussions on their effectiveness, security implications, and impact on the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles that introduce or review specific AI-powered tools designed to facilitate various aspects of research, from data analysis to hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze customer data, understand behavior, and derive actionable insights for product development and marketing strategies.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles discussing the application of AI in automating or enhancing usability testing processes, including AI-driven test generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts, research papers, or customer feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Content exploring the creation and use of artificial user personas or data to simulate human behavior for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI tools and techniques are being integrated into the design and research phases of product development, influencing workflows and outputs.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Research findings and discussions on the behavior, impact, and user experiences related to AI-powered chatbots across various applications.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare and contrast different AI tools designed for research, evaluating their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
